name: Albino Horror VR: Remastered
summary: Albino Horror VR: Remastered is a new and improved remastered version of the last game: Albino Horror VR! This game has 7 levels, 15 cosmetics for you to buy and equip, 4 multiplayer servers, ect! You can change your color, and name! There can be up to 10 players in 1 server at a time! So you can play with friends and other people from around the globe!
